title: Primitive Quadratic Polynomials in Additive Coset Families
summary: Let \(q\) be an odd prime power. For \(μ\in\mathbb F_q^\times\) and an additive coset \(\barα\in\mathbb F_{q^2}/\mathbb F_q\), consider the family \[ \{x^2+μx-α:α\in\barα\}, \] where each polynomial is regarded over its coefficient field \(\mathbb F_q(α)\). We prove that, for \[ q\notin{7,11,13,19,29,31,41,43}, \] every such family contains a primitive polynomial. For the zero coset, the result follows from Cohen's prescribed-trace theorem.
